explanation: Compute all-pairs highway distances using Floyd–Warshall. For each proposal, sum pairwise savings obtained by traversing that edge in either direction. Keep the first proposal achieving the greatest savings.
timeComplexity: O(n³+pn²+h), for p proposals and h highways
